content.title: 1 Russell 2000 Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 Facing Headwinds
content.summary: The Russell 2000 (^RUT) is home to many small-cap stocks, offering investors the chance to uncover hidden gems before the broader market catches on. However, these companies often come with higher volatility and risk, as their smaller size makes them more vulnerable to economic downturns.

content.title: Amazon Is Getting Into the Car Business. Who That Hurts—and Helps.
content.summary: Amazon  entering any new business can make investors in that business a little nervous.  Amazon has disrupted—or tried to disrupt—retail, industrial distribution, logistics, groceries, tech, the internet, and a few others.  Hertz  and Amazon surprised investors on Wednesday, announcing a partnership to sell used Hertz vehicles on the Amazon Autos platform.

content.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 Walking a Fine Line
content.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.

content.title: 3 Growth Companies With Insider Ownership Ranging From 15% To 29%
content.summary: As the U.S. stock market continues its rally with major indices like the S&P 500 and Nasdaq reaching new highs, investors are increasingly looking for opportunities in growth companies that offer both potential returns and stability. One key factor that can indicate a company's commitment to long-term success is high insider ownership, which often aligns management interests with those of shareholders and may be particularly appealing during times of heightened market optimism.
